# EnterpriseGlue v0.40.9 Release Notes

Generated from release-note fragments changed since `v0.40.8`.

## Highlights

- **frontend:** Opens the account menu’s organization switcher from the memberships already loaded for the signed-in account.
- **frontend:** Speeds up verified workspace entry and makes project member access easier to read.

## User and administrator impact

- The account menu can show organization choices immediately after the membership list loads.
- The dashboard can show results as soon as the workspace reads finish for platform administrators.
- Text can appear while the bundled IBM Plex fonts load.
- Project member dialogs show names when available and keep assignment diagnostics out of tenant users' view.

## Database migrations

- Database rollback supported for the combined release: yes.

## Security

- The server verifies the destination membership when switching organizations.
- Workspace access still requires matching authenticated session context and permission checks.

## Documentation

- Release notes describe how the account menu loads organization choices.
- Release notes describe the dashboard startup check, font loading, and project role visibility.

## Validation evidence

- Organization selection browser tests verify inline switching, last-used focus, and cross-tab session handling.
- Frontend unit tests preserve the setup guard for standalone deployments and delegated administrators.
- Chromium and Firefox open and reload an authenticated pooled workspace with no duplicate setup request.
- Project member dialog tests cover named role assignments and visibility of diagnostics.
- Compared cold sign-in text paint in production builds with delayed IBM Plex fonts.
